acceptance: Record git status, selected branch/SHA and newer-work check. Preserve all unrelated work.
Show lab config contains no live trunks or customer credentials; unknown destinations are denied.
Report acceleration, tools, image/ABI, SIP/media reachability and audio capabilities without exposing secrets.
Build actual Android lab APK; record application ID, manifest, SHA-256 and native libraries.
Install on explicit emulator; actual native runtime reports the pinned Android SDK version; no fake fallback.
No competing SIP runtime, Telecom owner or duplicated call notification in lab variant.
Self-contained APK opens with Metro absent; core state is not supplied by a dev-server session.
Shared contract tests and relevant source/config regressions pass; separately disclose unrun iOS runtime tests.
Registration and call state follow vendor callbacks; snapshots reconcile missed listeners.
Reject old generations/account context; failed destruction is not falsely reported successful.
Unsupported platform features reject explicitly; no successful no-op methods.
Actual REGISTER result and SDK callback correlate; UI agrees with native state.
No false registered state, password leak or infinite retry; actionable sanitized failure.
Bounded timeout, truthful state, recovery after approved lab connectivity returns.
20 proposed primary-image attempts; correct dialing/ringing/connected/terminated transitions.
20 proposed primary-image attempts; real INVITE, one call surface, answer reaches peer.
Rejection terminates the actual peer call; no lingering service/notification/history error.
Correct canceled/missed outcome; no ghost ringing after cancellation.
Call and pending resources expire; exactly one appropriate history record.
Local and remote termination synchronize; later calls work without app restart.
Documented single-call/busy policy; no second phantom active session.
Answer/hangup/dial duplication remains idempotent and does not corrupt call state.
Where supported, distinguish 180 without SDP from early media; otherwise record unsupported fixture detail.
Native state and peer-observed audio agree; command-only proof is insufficient for the audio assertion.
Hold callbacks/state and resumed media agree; a pending hold command cannot corrupt state.
Receiving fixture observes expected digits in order, not only a UI event.
Record requested versus observed virtual route; do not claim physical earpiece/acoustic validation.
Synthetic known input reaches the peer through a verified actual app media path.
Known peer signal observed after valid client decode/output; RTP count alone does not pass.
Optional computer microphone/desktop-peer check is labeled manual; permissions and evidence recorded.
Deliberately block one lab media direction; report fails that assertion instead of passing on SIP success.
Call state survives supported recreation; no duplicate runtime, lost controls or fabricated connection.
Record lifecycle transition separately from process death; foreground-only polling does not keep it alive.
Observe actual native/process/service state; distinguish removal from force-stop.
With process truly absent and not force-stopped, real push/call path starts without React UI or Metro.
No attempt to bypass stopped state; explicit relaunch restores eligible message/call handling.
Bounded retries and truthful registration; recovery does not create duplicate accounts.
Observe documented disconnect/recovery; no silent stuck connected badge after timeout.
When TLS is supported, invalid/untrusted certificate fails; no permissive production trust bypass.
Calls/registrations/credentials cleaned according to policy; stale callbacks cannot attach to new user.
Malformed, expired, duplicate and wrong-binding payloads are rejected or deduplicated as designed.
User/tenant/device/session binding checks use actual contract; no ad hoc accept-all fixture logic in app.
20 proposed eligible calls; correlate pending-call creation, push, native wake, INVITE and ring/answer.
20 proposed eligible calls; observe real lock state and permission-appropriate incoming-call surface.
20 proposed eligible calls; prove idle entry and no hidden keep-alive; report every miss and timing.
One visible call/session only; repeated messages cannot create duplicate history or answer.
Cancel before readiness and during answer race yields truthful terminated state with no ghost ring.
Expired/canceled pending call never becomes a fresh call after connectivity returns.
Client and server agree on updated registration identifier; old binding is safely retired.
No call or sensitive history becomes visible to a logged-out or different user/tenant/device.
Bounded failure and meaningful pending-call expiry; no claim of guaranteed wake.
No crash, unauthorized capture or false audible-call success; clear supported recovery.
Observe supported behavior accurately; respect settings rather than grant permissions silently.
Supported notification/action fallback; no forced background activity workaround.
Merged manifest and observed service start/audio capture comply with tested target SDK ownership.
Zero tests, missing evidence, failed audio and blocked required push cannot appear as full PASS.
No passwords, authorization headers, push destinations or customer data in shareable artifacts.
Fresh approved runner can execute runbook; cleanup restores only this run resources and emulator state.
Offline PR checks have no live secrets; approved runtime jobs do not run untrusted code on trusted hosts.
